# R003F / R0041 implementation roadmap

## Goal
Carry the original EBPM73 and EWM77 qualification through one combined draft PR and retain embedded BWP234/41/608 separately.

## Audit object
The unchanged owner commission and complete issue225/230 records. Accepted EPM229 documentary/receiving evidence remains limited to its certificate. Selected source baseline e78f7cb21af4197d490f10bc95917a4c75f748aa.

## Action selection and amendment
This amendment permits a reviewed source/target carrier increment to be published while independently started EBPM/EWM receiving continues. It makes that increment's actual CI available before final receiving and composition adjudication. It neither marks the original work orders accepted nor retires predecessor content. The original three acceptance populations, negative findings, authority ceiling and existing runtime ownership remain unchanged.

Selected: retain completed exact recovery and checks; reconcile independent revision review; publish one guarded initial carrier increment; receive the active frozen-input model lanes; separately assess the embedded component; review and publish qualified subsequent increments; read each public head/tree and actual CI. Minimal runtime correction remains contingent on a reproduced current-source defect.

Omitted: new engine/controller, new general migration mechanism, corpus-wide campaign, unsupported native/benefit/autonomy claims, mutation of another executor's branch, release/merge/automatic issue closure.

| Phase | Objective | Owner/source | Depends on | Smoke A | Smoke B | Review | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Preserve completed original reconstruction and original failed/corrected candidate evidence | Existing research sources and combined carrier | - | Completed source baselines | 73/77/234/41/608 and guarded-content conservation | Independent initial review plus explicit corrected-tree delta | IN_PHASE until revised review accepted |
| 2 | Publish the reviewed initial carrier; observe exact remote tree and real CI | Existing combined branch and GitHub PR interface | Phase1 accepted; unchanged expected public parent | Exact branch head and authorised automatic effects | Public commit/tree and sole draft PR readback | Accepted exact candidate, no pending receiver result promoted | READY after Phase1 |
| 3 | Finish active receiving, actual local plan-transition observation and independent component decision; publish guarded qualified increments | Existing decision, lifecycle, configuration, effect and receiving owners | Frozen inputs and actual returned lane evidence; initial public carrier | Preserve actual current state and contrary evidence | Separate EBPM, EWM and embedded BWP outcomes, applicable checks and actual CI | Fresh or disclosed continuation review; no repeated-evidence inflation | IN_PROGRESS for existing receiving only |

Only pro/r003f-r0041-bwp-20261024 and exactly one new combined draft PR. No merge, release, newRXX, automatic closure, protected effects, or mutations to PR246/251/253/252. The three recovery lanes are DONE and their exact outputs remain accessible. Initial review and revised review retain separate evidence and correlated-review disclosure. If the amendment is declined, retain the old roadmap and all completed/active work.
